limitations: Single static deposited crystal models, not solution-state ensembles.
Equal-weight geometric radius of gyration, not a measured SAXS Rg.

Catalytic role of lysozyme's Glu35/Asp52 is established literature consensus cited in the entry's own reference list, not re-derived here.
note: Completes the biology x 1-10 nm cell to 10/10 together with bio-nm-v04-001. First RNA structure used in this project (1EHZ), adding a third macromolecule class alongside protein and DNA.
